newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai Tyre & Rubber expects profit.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai Tyre & Rubber expects profit.

text.p: Shanghai Tyre & Rubber Co expects to see a net profit of 10 million yuan in 1996 against a 1995 loss of 170 million yuan after sales rose and rubber prices fell, a company official said on Friday.
The official, contacted by telephone, also said that according to domestic accounting standards, the company expects a pre-tax profit of 140 million yuan in 1996, up from 10.5 million yuan in 1995.
In the first eight months of 1996, it made a pre-tax profit of 102 million yuan, up 89 percent from the same 1995 period, also under domestic accounting standards, he said.
Shanghai Tyre & Rubber has started to build its second car tyre processing line, which will double its annual capacity to three million when completed in one year's time, he said.
The company currently held about 50 percent of the domestic passenger car tyre market and 80 percent of the domestic truck tyre market, the official said.
Since the beginning of 1996, the company has cut the average cost of production of a tyre to 181 yuan from 214 yuan and reduced management costs by 20 percent, he said.
Higher tyre prices and lower raw material costs also boosted the company's profit, he said.
